changeSet.sql: if not exists (select * from sys.objects where object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[CompanyFeatureFlag]') and type in (N'U')) begin create table dbo.CompanyFeatureFlag ( CompanyID int, FeatureFlagId smallint not null, [Value] bit not null, constraint PK_CompanyFeatureFlag primary key clustered (CompanyID asc, FeatureFlagId asc) ) end
